_comment: Cause and effect for 'Ayusin ayon sa oras' (see scripts/time_threads.gd): after the recap, the run's moments are put in true time order and a red thread joins each cause to its effect. A thread is drawn only when both ends happened in this run, and only forward in story time. Echoes are tied to the choice that set their flag on their own; these are the other links. A 'choice' is matched by its words, an 'outcome' by its ending id.

from.choice: Ikaw na lang muna. May pickup pa 'ko.
Ito na lang. Ako na'ng bahala kay Ben.
Hintayin mo 'ko. Sabay na tayong lumabas.
Ama, aaminin ko na ang lahat.
Pakisabi pong magsama siya ng tanod.
